records.schema: RSS XML；channel/item 至少包含 title、link、pubDate 或等价时间字段；受限探针只验证结构不保存全文
records.rate_limit: 官方材料未公布数值；本地策略固定同主机并发 1、无重试风暴，准入探测仅 1 次
records.history_range: 实时 Feed 当前窗口，不宣称历史完整；历史研究不得用该列表替代完整历史源
records.allowed_storage: conservative candidate boundary: feed metadata, canonical URL and short evidence excerpt only; no full article mirror

records.schema: Atom 1.0; entries document id, updated, published, title, summary, authors, categories and links; exact live response not probed
records.rate_limit: official guidance: one connection and no more than one request every three seconds; cache results
records.history_range: query API supports paging over matching records; practical requested time windows still require an authorized probe
records.allowed_storage: descriptive metadata may be retrieved, stored, transformed and shared; do not store or serve papers/source unless the item license permits

records.schema: GDELT DOC 2.0 ArticleList JSON discovery response; exact current fields and response media type not probed
records.rate_limit: not published in reviewed official DOC API material; local policy must enforce bounded serial requests
records.history_range: official DOC API material documents rolling search windows that vary by mode/version; exact current window must be probed
records.allowed_storage: GDELT metadata and discovered URLs with required GDELT citation; no third-party publisher full text without separate permission

records.schema: 登记仓库 Releases Atom Feed；entry 包含 id、title、updated、link 与 content；只保留标签、时间和规范 URL
records.rate_limit: 公开 Atom Feed 未公布独立数值；本地策略固定同主机并发 1、条件请求和有界退避
records.history_range: 登记仓库当前 Releases Feed 窗口；不宣称完整发布历史或仓库外覆盖
records.allowed_storage: release identifiers, tags, timestamps and canonical URLs; body/assets require repository-specific license review before persistence

records.schema: Firebase JSON 顶层整数 ID 数组；后续 item 端点可返回 type、by、time、title、url、score 等字段
records.rate_limit: official API documentation states there is currently no rate limit; local bounded request policy still applies
records.history_range: top/new/best 当前列表最多 500 个 ID；不是时间窗完整历史，向后遍历必须另行有界规划
records.allowed_storage: conservative candidate boundary: item id, timestamp, score, title and canonical URL only; user text/comments require separate terms review
